'''Chapter 33''' is titled "The Man Who Makes No Sound".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]]: [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Nami]] soar through the sky in biplanes; along for the ride on Zoro's plane are [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Wikipedia:King Kong|a massive gorilla]].

==Short Summary==
[[Kuro]], having just arrived on the scene, wonders how the [[Black Cat Pirates]] could be having such problems from a bunch of children. [[Jango]] says that Kuro himself said that [[Usopp]] would not be a problem, and [[Sham]] and [[Buchi]] say that while Kuro was getting soft, they were out fighting. Sham and Buchi attack, but Kuro evades their attacks and states that he will kill everyone present if the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] are not dead in five minutes. Sham and Buchi attack [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] once more, but [[Nami]] kicks Zoro his two stolen swords. With all three blades, Zoro then defeats Sham and Buchi in a single move. Buchi, however, survives and convinces Jango to hypnotize him in being stronger. While Zoro takes on Buchi, Nami runs to wake up [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], forcing Jango to throw a chakram at her.

==Long Summary==
[[Kuro]] demands to know how the [[Black Cat Pirates]] were beaten by a bunch of children. [[Jango]] states it was Kuro himself that said [[Usopp]] would not be a problem, but Kuro just states that the Black Cats are weaker than he thought they were.

[[Buchi]] and [[Sham]] cannot believe what they are hearing. They try to argue that while Kuro has been leading a peaceful existence in the village, they have been fighting hard against other pirates and plundering other villages and that in three years they have gotten a lot stronger. They attempt to kill Kuro before he kills them, but to their horror Kuro dodges the attack. He appears behind them but when they turn to strike, he once again appears behind them again with his special weapons, the [[Cat Claws]], pointing at the pairs' throats. Jango comments how, with those weapons, Kuro can move silently and that Kuro's habit of lifting up his glasses still makes his hair stand on end. Kuro tells the [[Black Cat Pirates#Nyaban Brothers|Nyaban Brothers]] they have 5 minutes to kill them or he will kill everyone.

With renewed hope, the pair rush at Zoro. [[Nami]] kicks Zoro his swords, much to Zoro's annoyance. With all three swords in his hands, Zoro easily defeats the pair with a single move. Zoro points his sword at Kuro and states he is next. However, attention is drawn to Buchi, who still has survived Zoro's attack. Buchi demands that Jango [[Jango#Hypnotism|hypnotize]] him so he can continue fighting.

While Zoro tackles the hypnotized Buchi, Nami makes an attempt to wake [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] up. Jango spots this and throws his ring at her.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*Members of the [[Black Cat Pirates]] confirm that [[Jango]] cannot beat both Nyaban Brothers at once. 
**However, Captain [[Kuro]] was easily able to overwhelm them and could have beaten them if he wanted to. 
* After that display, [[Jango]] goes on to explain some of Captain [[Kuro|Kuro's]] notorious skills. 
*After seeing how weak his old crew is, [[Kuro]] plans to kill [[Black Cat Pirates|them]] all unless they kill the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] in five minutes.
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] defeats the Nyaban Brothers but then [[Buchi]] gets hypnotized by [[Jango]] and the fight continues. 
**While that happens, [[Nami]] goes to wake up [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]].
